title: F4 + F2 + F3 + F6 REAL AI: Create offers "Build it in my brand" (on by default); turned OFF, the job carries no kit and the deck is NOT in the brand
E1 Apply everything: colours, fonts and the logo reach EVERY slide; ONE undo reverts all
E2 + E3 only ticked parts apply; applying twice never doubles the logo
E4 + E5 a kit without a logo leaves the deck's logo alone; a kit without colours has the Colours box off
E7 formats 16:9, 4:3 and 1:1: the logo sits in the margin, inside the slide, and never over other content (screenshots kept)
E8 Present mode shows the logo on every slide
E9 Export PPTX: the logo image is on every slide of the file and the kit's fonts are in it
E10 switching the deck to Light mode afterwards keeps the logo and the brand colours (the brand accent is still the kit's)
J1 + J2 five real sites are looked up in the editor and applied to a deck; screenshots are kept to be read by eye
F5 + J3 REAL AI: a kit saved from a website lookup (Zerodha) → "Build it in my brand" → the generated deck has its colours, a logo on every slide, and costs the same as the plain deck
F7 a kit deleted while the Create screen was open: the job is refused or made without it with a plain message, never a stuck screen
